**STEP 1 - Scene:** A British-style breakfast on an airline-style tray, photographed from the front at a slight elevation. Items are a fried egg, grilled tomato halves, mushrooms, two English muffins, a banana and a mug of milky coffee.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The main plate is about 23 cm across, so its area is 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ 415 cm². The muffin plate is about 19 cm, and the banana sits on a side plate of about 17 cm. Only the items on the main plate and the tray are counted in the area calculation.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Fried egg, grilled tomato halves (2), button mushrooms (3), English muffins (2), banana, milky coffee.

**STEP 4 - Area (of the 415 cm² main plate):**
- Fried egg: about 13% (55 cm²)
- Tomato halves: about 12% (48 cm²)
- Mushrooms: about 5% (22 cm²)

Food on the main plate covers about 30% of it. The muffins and banana are on their own plates and are measured by their dimensions instead.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Egg: 55 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 66 ml
- Tomatoes: 48 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Mushrooms: 22 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 44 ml
- Muffins: each about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm thick, so about 160 ml each
- Banana: about 15 cm long and 3.5 cm across, roughly one medium banana
- Coffee: about 200 ml in the mug

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Egg: 66 ml × 0.95 ≈ 63 g
- Tomatoes: 96 ml × 0.6 ≈ 58 g
- Mushrooms: 44 ml × 0.6 ≈ 26 g
- Muffins: the volume-based density gives an implausible ~140 g each, so I used the typical weight of a whole English muffin, about 55 g each, giving 110 g
- Banana: about 100 g
- Coffee: about 200 g (milky, so it is roughly 200 ml)

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Egg: 63 g × 196 kcal/100 g ≈ 123 kcal
- Tomatoes: 58 g × 25 ≈ 15 kcal
- Mushrooms: 26 g × 25 ≈ 7 kcal
- Muffins: 110 g × 235 ≈ 259 kcal
- Banana: 100 g × 89 ≈ 89 kcal
- Coffee: 200 g × 35 ≈ 70 kcal (milk and sugar not visible, so this is approximate)

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Solid food totals about 357 g and about 493 kcal, which is plausible for a full English-style breakfast of this size. Adding the coffee gives about 557 g and about 563 kcal. Most of the uncertainty is in the muffin weight and the unseen milk and sugar in the coffee.
